function logged(label: string) {
  console.log('evaluate', label);
  return <T>(value: T): T => value;
}
function base(label: string): new () => object {
  console.log('extends', label);
  return Object;
}
function key(): string {
  console.log('key');
  return 'greet';
}
@logged('class')
class Greeter extends base('declaration') {
  @logged('method')
  [key()]() {
    return 'hello';
  }
}
const Anonymous = @logged('expression') class extends base('expression') {};
console.log(new Greeter() instanceof Greeter, typeof Anonymous);
